newsitem.title: SPAIN: Folgado sees 10-yr yield spread flat in H1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Folgado sees 10-yr yield spread flat in H1 1997.

text.p: Spanish Budget Secretary Jose Folgado said on Monday that he expected the yield spread between Spanish and German bonds to remain flat in the first half.
But he added that there was then scope for further falls through the spring of 1998.
"The spread is going to be at an impassse in the first half," Folgado told Reuters in an interview. "But from then it could fall through the spring of 1998.
On Monday, the spread between 10-year Spanish government bonds to Germany was 91 basis points, above its all-time low of 83 points, but well beneath last March's 330 basis points.
